concepts.label: UPDATE STATISTICS FOR INDEX / ANALYZE INDEX (single-index syntax)
concepts.note: no prior term in registry; one of several syntactic forms of the UPDATE STATISTICS statement

relations.subject: n1ql:update-statistics-single-index
relations.evidence: In Couchbase Server 6.5 and later, the index type for a secondary index must be Global Secondary Index (GSI). The `USING GSI` keywords are optional and may be omitted.

relations.subject: n1ql:update-statistics-single-index
relations.note: the WITH-clause option table (sample_size, resolution, update_statistics_timeout, batch_size) on this page is word-for-word identical to the one on statistics-indexes.md
relations.evidence: sample\_size [Optional] An integer specifying the sample size to use for distribution statistics. A minimum sample size is also calculated... resolution [Optional] A float representing the percentage of documents to store in each distribution bin... update\_statistics\_timeout [Optional] A number representing a duration in seconds... batch\_size [Optional] Only applies when processing multiple index expressions at once...
